body:
CHECK MAINLINE-028b. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The owner's card is not rewritten. The arithmetic is independent of the owner's scripts.

No mismatch at the printed precision. Fourteen published floating points were rebuilt from the fixed reserve, stock panels and the joining bill. Mass, seam length and the six modes match.

Two factors suffice. On the seam-enforced sheet-Poisson points the least set is gamma and wrinkling. Nominal usage is 0.97197751743, primer usage is 0.996076438087, and the laboratory weld usage is 0.651468543105. Gamma alone stays above 1. Wrinkling alone, face strength alone, and the empty set stay infeasible. Adding face strength leaves the two-factor usage unchanged.

The 255 MPa sensitivity has no floating set. With zero core and the whole structural budget in the faces, the compression factor is 0.958217295476. Core mass or joint excess leaves a thinner face. The published full-endpoint screens stay below 1. The highest is 0.870902327232.

The 10 MPa scarf screen sets the two higher usages. The screen is an assumed numerical limit. That objection is NFI-CHECK-028B-SEAM-SCREEN. The face-budget bound is NFI-CHECK-028B-255-BOUND. This check names no next job.
